title: What Is Class 11 Maths About? Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
One bicycle ride to college hides a count, a speed, an angle and a curve. This year you learn the tools to describe every one of them exactly. This is the first video of our PUC Maths playlist for Class 11 (NCERT): a clear start before Chapter 1, so you know what you are learning and have the basic tools ready.

You will see what Class 11 maths really is (a language for patterns, not faster sums), the map of all 14 NCERT chapters and the four this playlist starts with: Sets, Relations and Functions, Trigonometric Functions, and Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations. Then your toolkit: the number system from natural numbers to real numbers, the decimal test that tells rational from irrational, equations and inequalities on the number line, and the symbols you will meet in every episode. A worked example sorts six numbers into their families, the exam trap shows why pi is not 22/7, and an original JEE Main pattern question tests it all, followed by a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 One bicycle ride, four kinds of maths
0:25 Class 11 maths is a language
0:37 The map of the year: 14 chapters
1:07 Tool 1: the number system
1:50 The decimal test: rational or irrational?
2:31 Tool 2: equations and inequalities
3:05 Tool 3: symbols in every episode
3:27 How every episode runs
3:44 Worked example: sort six numbers
4:20 Exam trap: is pi 22/7?
4:45 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:24 Recap and three questions to answer
